scope_precision: Global normal proper connected surfaces over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p>0, arbitrary original fixed-divisor tame boundary, q=p^f, Brauer-zero PGL_r(F_q) representations only. Centres may grow. Nonzero geometric Brauer classes, complete-local cases, cross-characteristic families and general nonabelian crowns remain open. General D1/D2(ii)/L8 requested rows remain open.
gate_subtraction: Unlike the bounded-centre theorem, permits nonzero Kummer lifting classes of unbounded scalar order; finite digits replace any need for one open subgroup killing all coefficient orders. No ordinary finite-field GL lift is assumed.
assembly_status: Checked postCP16 source ready for root central integration; three units constitute one scoped main-gate reduction.
certificate: Not applicable: no concrete finite numerical example is introduced.
